items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember that on an occasion he had some musicians over to his home just to socialize – just to, as we say, hang out.

ctx.x: I was about to say, I bet you, with Israel and other pieces . .

Johnny Carisi. I remember that on an occasion he had some musicians over to his home just to socialize – just to, as we say, hang out. He played for me – the first time I had ever heard [it] – Stravinsky’s The Rite of Spring.
